verdict.rationale: Kitty's own docs advertise "Programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts to manage windows," including a Splits Layout and window resizing. A hands-on probe confirmed live window/tab/layout state via remote control, and community users praise its window organisation and auto layouts as a reason to drop tmux. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of split/tab keybindings and workflows (most doc items are section titles only), and evidence of multiplexer-style session detach/persistence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split windows into panes and organize work across tabs without an external multiplexer
